title: HybridRobotics/supermimic
why_read: A robotics research project for humanoid motion tracking using a single differentiable physics-based world model, relevant to anyone working on robot learning or simulation.
analysis: This project focuses on getting humanoid robots to imitate full-body human motion capture data using model-based reinforcement learning techniques. The key technical idea is using one differentiable world model, meaning a simulator whose physics can be back-propagated through, rather than separate hand-tuned controllers for different behaviors. This approach is part of a broader trend in robotics research toward using differentiable simulation to make training more sample-efficient and generalizable. It's a focused, technically substantial repository for people working in humanoid robotics or physics-based character animation.
